text: The Sorceress's fires burn hotter than nature allows. Every enemy on the field is more vulnerable to fire.
Nearby allies' weapons are wreathed in flame.
Shadows gather around the Sorceress, hiding nearby allies and quickening their steps.
Dark Elf units near this daemon of Slaanesh feel Pain, and fight with ecstatic skill.
Daemons near this Dark Elf unit feel Pleasure, striking harder and shrugging off blows.
While an enemy spellcaster is near, Morathi steals the Winds of Magic from their reserves.
Morathi channels the Winds of Magic with terrifying ease, and the overflow scorches enemies within 35m.
Daemons of Slaanesh give nearby Dark Elf units Pain (+8 melee attack, +8 melee defence); Dark Elf units give nearby daemons Pleasure (+10% weapon strength, +10% physical resistance)
Druchii and daemon fight as one.
